security: Dedicated encho_composition_worker role with NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION; RLS forced on canonical_payable_authorities and canonical_payment_reservations; runtime roles explicitly revoked from canonical_payable_authorities; encho_composition_worker denied direct EXECUTE on canonical_finalize_direct_hold; web and payment workers denied EXECUTE on canonical_compose_payment_reservation; composition runtime has zero raw DML on canonical tables; narrow SECURITY DEFINER procedures execute verified composition.
conclusion: W3-B Task 3 composition authority is repaired and verified on real PostgreSQL. The authority model separates W2 accepted-offer quotes (which strictly retain total_paise and tax_paise NULL) from final payable amount authority (owned by canonical_payable_authorities). In this contract, payable authority lifecycle is simplified to exactly one immutable APPROVED authority per quote, with quote_id UNIQUE, status check enforced to 'APPROVED', and UPDATE/DELETE blocked. In production, payable authority remains legally gated (PAYABLE_AUTHORITY_MISSING). In isolated tests, owner inserts a DISPOSABLE TEST FIXTURE ONLY payable authority row, allowing canonical_create_payment_attempt to derive expected amount and reach MATCHED_CAPTURE with matching provider evidence. Composition strictly requires exact authority identity match (ref, kind, hash, amount, currency, and quote_id); equal-amount different-contract authorities fail closed. Real two-connection races verify row-level serialization between canonical_ingest_provider_event and canonical_compose_payment_reservation in both directions without raw updates. Role privileges enforce strict least privilege without backdoor execution.
limitations: No real money movement, remote Neon mutation, live Razorpay API, STAAH integration or public checkout was executed. Production payable authority issuer remains missing and legally gated pending written Indian CA/tax-lawyer sign-off. Test-only payable authority fixture was used exclusively for internal verification testing.
